notes.title: Grapple Car Demo Update 1.1
notes.content:
Huge thanks to everyone that has played the demo so far! I'm so happy to hear you are having fun with my game :)

This patch includes a few community requested features, bug-fixes, and general quality of life improvements. 


PATCH NOTES:

CHANGES:
Improved grapple steering consistency

Disabled right thumb stick click to look behind

Improved tutorial level set-dressing and added some details

Add start/finish line decal for better clarity of where laps start

Added quick restart button

Added controller rumble, along with an option to disable it in the options for those of you who are not fans

Added a bug report button to the main menu for you to... uh... report bugs


BUG-FIXES:
Fixed bug that happened if you paused as you go in the water

Fixed a few UI bugs where it showed the wrong amount of car points

It is no longer possible to submit a lap-time if you haven't finished a full lap (should fix the bottom of the leaderboard being filled with a bunch of 999999 scores)

Fixed a couple of PT-BR translation errors
